key_facts: Aug 3 UPDATE (T+1d; MAJOR Exa BREAKTHROUGH from en.sudannow.net Aug 2 + bbc.com Aug 3; UPDATED): Sudan Now (Aug 2, 17:18) explicitly named the two RSF commanders killed in the Aug 2 Ghorra Al-Zawiya (North Darfur, NW of Kutum) drone/clash incident: Maj.
